QuestInfo.name: Fact or Fiction
QuestInfo.0: Alcaster has important news. Maybe he's found a clue! Go speak with him.
QuestInfo.1: Alcaster claims he spotted Oda's men. It could be Ranmaru. Head through the portal near Alcaster to investigate.
QuestInfo.2: It wasn't Ranmaru, but Nobunaga definitely had something to do with this incident. And to make matters worse, there's a conspiracy that involves not just Nobunaga, but the nefarious Black Wings too. You should report back to Momijigaoka quickly.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,530\nCan proceed to the Deepening Suspicion quest

mob.0: The suspicious people that you're looking for were through the portal near Alcaster in El Nath. You'd better hurry.
